text:
```yaml
name: Skills Build and Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Run linter
        run: golangci-lint run

      - name: Build
        run: go build ./cmd/thv-operator/...

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: go test -v ./pkg/...

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: go test -v ./test/integration/...
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file defines two jobs: `build` and `test`. The `build` job sets up the Go environment, installs dependencies, runs the linter, and builds the project. The `test` job depends on the `build` job and runs unit and integration tests for the project.
